Dear Borealis Manufacturing AS team,

Thank you for quotation BOR-2026-0418 for 2,000 units of Product X at USD 12.80 per unit with a 10-day lead time. We would like to place this order with you, but to fit our plan we need a unit price of USD 11.78 and delivery within 8 days. Could you confirm whether you can meet these terms? We are ready to confirm the order promptly on your reply.

Kind regards,
Procurement Team

reveals_other_terms.instructions: This message reveals a price, offer or terms from a supplier other than Borealis Manufacturing AS.

names_competitor.instructions: This message names or refers to a competing supplier.
